article.title: BlueMedia公布面向中國出海品牌的ChatGPT Ads服務
article.summary: BlueMedia稱已為首批品牌客戶投放ChatGPT Ads，服務涵蓋策略、到達頁審查和投放監測。
highlights: 公司列出電商、旅遊和AI應用的行業方案。
公告未列出首批客戶投放市場和商業條款。
article.why: 出海團隊可先核對目標市場資格和量度方法，再評估代投服務。
article.next_step: 索取適用市場、帳戶及追蹤資料的管理安排，確認後才設定試投預算。
article.detail: BlueMedia公布面向中國出海品牌的ChatGPT Ads服務，並稱已為首批品牌客戶投放。公司描述的服務包括受眾意圖分析、到達頁審查、執行和監測，另列出電商、旅遊及AI應用的行業方案。公告未列明首批投放市場或條款，品牌應按目標市場逐一確認資格與數據取得方式。
article.title_en: BlueMedia announces ChatGPT Ads services for Chinese brands going abroad
article.summary_en: BlueMedia says it has run ChatGPT Ads for its first group of brand clients. Its service spans strategy, landing page review and monitoring.
highlights_en: The company lists services for ecommerce, travel and AI applications.
The release did not specify the initial clients' ad markets or commercial terms.
article.why_en: Cross-border teams can check market eligibility and measurement before assessing managed services.
article.next_step_en: Ask about supported markets, account control and tracking access before setting a test budget.
article.detail_en: BlueMedia announced ChatGPT Ads services for Chinese brands going abroad and said it had run campaigns for an initial group of clients. Its stated services cover intent analysis, landing page review, execution and monitoring, with sector offerings for ecommerce, travel and AI apps. The release did not name initial ad markets or terms. Check eligibility and data access for each target market.
